key_safety.text: Very well tolerated. In pooled phase 3 trials adverse events occurred in 16/352 (4.4%) of ozenoxacin patients vs 17/361 (4.7%) placebo; the only AEs reported in ≥2 ozenoxacin patients were nasopharyngitis (4) and diarrhea (2). In the label, adverse reactions (rosacea and seborrheic dermatitis) were reported in 1 adult patient treated with XEPI. No deaths and no study-drug-related SAEs occurred in the development program.
